body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2011') -- <Visual News> Pandora introduced internet radio service at CES 2011

Pandora, the leading personalized internet radio service, gives people music they love anytime, everywhere, through a wide variety of devices. Personalized stations launch instantly with the input of a single "seed" such as a favorite artist, song or genre and are further personalized with simple "thumbs-up" and "thumbs-down" feedback. During 2010 alone, Pandora listeners gave more than 3 billion "thumbs" to personalize their stations.

Pandora is free, simple and, thanks to connectivity, available everywhere consumers are: at the office, at home, in the car, and all points in between. Truly personalized radio means playlists full of old favorites, and great new discoveries – carefully tuned to each listener. It represents the future of radio, and is a craft Pandora has been focused on for over 10 years, constantly learning, adjusting and innovating.
